model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the training loss over the number of iterations for five different models: Vanilla, StrmLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64, H), SepLLM (n=64, H/T), and SepLLM (n=128). The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration", spans from 0 to 140,000 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 20,000. The y-axis, labeled "Loss", ranges from 2.4 to 3.4 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 0.1. All five lines start near a loss of 3.4 at iteration 0 and exhibit a steep decline before gradually converging to lower loss values. The purple line (Vanilla) shows the lowest loss throughout, ending near 2.5 at 140,000 iterations. The blue line (StrmLLM, n=64) consistently has the highest loss, starting at 3.4 and ending near 2.6. The orange line (SepLLM, n=64, H) and green line (SepLLM, n=64, H/T) follow similar trajectories, both starting near 3.4 and ending near 2.5, with the green line slightly below the orange. The dark blue line (SepLLM, n=128) starts near 3.4 and ends near 2.5, positioned between the green and purple lines. All lines are solid and show slight noise or fluctuation, particularly evident in the blue line, indicating variability in loss during training.
